name: EU Warranty Ready
author: ajescudero

sections.description:
EU Warranty Ready integrates the official EU harmonised legal guarantee notice into WooCommerce, with automatic support for all 24 official EU languages.

The free plugin adds the official notice to WooCommerce product pages, automatically selecting the appropriate language from your WordPress locale. Everything runs locally inside WordPress: no external account, no SaaS dependency, and no customer data is transmitted.

Built for WooCommerce stores and agencies that want a lightweight, predictable way to add the official EU warranty information without introducing another consumer platform or external service.

Features in the free plugin

  • Official EU harmonised legal guarantee notice on WooCommerce product pages.
  • All 24 official EU languages.
  • Automatic language selection from the WordPress locale.
  • Manual language override when needed.
  • Optional custom link text.
  • Click-to-open notice with a direct link to the corresponding Your Europe guarantee information.
  • Runs entirely inside WordPress.
  • No external SaaS account.
  • No customer-data transmission by the plugin.

This plugin is intended to help store owners display the specified notice. It does not provide, automate, or guarantee legal compliance, and it is not legal advice. Site owners remain responsible for determining which legal requirements apply to their store.

EU Warranty Ready is an independent WooCommerce plugin and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the European Union or the European Commission.

Free and Pro

The WordPress.org version is fully functional for displaying the official EU legal guarantee notice on WooCommerce product pages.

EU Warranty Ready Pro extends the warranty information across the WooCommerce customer journey:

  • WooCommerce Checkout Blocks.
  • Classic WooCommerce checkout.
  • Customer order emails.
  • Product-specific EU GARAN durability labels.

Pro is a separate plugin sold outside WordPress.org. It runs inside WordPress and does not require a recurring SaaS subscription.

More information: EU Warranty Ready

Third Party Content

The official EU harmonised legal guarantee notice artwork is published by the European Commission, Directorate-General for Justice and Consumers.

Source: European Commission — Practical guidelines and official EU notice files

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install and activate EU Warranty Ready.
  3. Open WooCommerce > EU Warranty Ready.
  4. Leave the notice language on Automatic or select one of the 24 supported EU languages.
  5. Open a WooCommerce product page and use the legal guarantee link to view the official notice.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin make my store legally compliant?

No. The plugin helps display the official EU harmonised legal guarantee notice in the supported WooCommerce location. It does not provide or guarantee legal compliance and is not legal advice.

Does the plugin alter the official EU notice?

No. The bundled notice SVG files are redistributed unmodified. The plugin displays the corresponding official RGB notice artwork.

Which languages are included?

The official notice artwork is included for all 24 official EU languages: Bulgarian, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hungarian, Irish, Italian, Latvian, Lithuanian, Maltese, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, and Swedish.

Does the plugin send customer data to another service?

No. The plugin runs inside WordPress and does not transmit customer data to an external SaaS service. When a visitor follows the official information link, their browser opens the corresponding Your Europe page.

What is included in Pro?

EU Warranty Ready Pro is a separate plugin that extends the warranty information across the WooCommerce customer journey with Checkout Blocks, classic checkout, customer order emails, and product-specific EU GARAN durability labels for eligible products. The free plugin does not contain locked Pro code.
